name: synscore
description: SynOmega synthesizability score computed from the count of non-purchasable starting materials in the best route

name: bb_coverage
description: Fraction of the best route starting materials that are purchasable

name: solved
description: One if a route within the depth limit was found with every starting material purchasable and zero otherwise

name: u
description: Number of starting materials in the best route that are not purchasable

name: min_steps
description: Reactions in the shortest solved route and empty when no solved route was found

name: min_route_depth
description: Longest linear sequence of the shortest solved route and empty when no solved route was found

name: num_routes
description: Number of distinct solved routes found for the target

name: num_leaves
description: Starting materials in the best route found

name: num_purchasable_leaves
description: Starting materials in the best route that are purchasable

name: expansions
description: Node expansions the search used for this target
